'''Acetoa''' or the '''Republic of Acetoa''' is a [[wikipedia:Unitary_parliamentary_republic| Unitary parliamentary republic]] located in [[North Acrola]]. Covering a total area of 388,005 square kilometres (approximately 131,864 square miles), the nation [[List of countries and dependencies by area|ranks 82nd globally]] in area. Acetoa borders [[Areoix Lie]] to the north, [[Feio Lie]] to the south, and [[Saa]] to the east. Its capital and largest urban centre is [[Yezhito]], which serves as the primary hub for the country’s political, cultural, and economic activities. As of 1765 AFA, Acetoa has an estimated population of approximately [[List of countries and dependencies by population|11.2 million people]], predominantly identifying as Acetoan and speaking the official [[Arten language]].

The recorded history of the region begins with the [[Arten settlement of Acetoa|Arten settlement]] in 1140 AFA, which established the foundational social and linguistic structures of the territory. For several centuries, the region maintained a consistent territorial footprint with minimal border shifts. In 1635 AFA, the territory was reorganised as a [[Sialq protectorate]] under the jurisdiction of [[Areoix Lie]]. This period of closer [[wikipedia:Dominion_administrative_oversight|Dominion administrative oversight]] lasted until the early 18th century. Acetoa achieved formal sovereignty in 1715 AFA following the [[Arten Revolution]] and the [[Declaration of Rights]] within [[Areoix Lie]]. Post-independence history has been defined by internal stability, though the state has navigated specific periods of civil strife, including ongoing border disputes with [[Saa]].

The political system of Acetoa is structured as a unitary parliamentary republic. Legislative authority is held by the [[Acetoan Little House|Little House]], a bicameral legislature comprising the [[Acetoan Lainar of the People|Lainar of the People]] (upper house) and the [[Acetoan National People's Congress|National People's Congress]] (lower house). The executive branch is headed by the Talu Mara and the Sialo Mara. While the nation transitioned from colonial status to independence, it retains a close diplomatic and functional relationship with its former sovereign, [[Areoix Lie]]. The legal system and administrative protocols are largely derived from the 4th century BFA.

The Acetoan economy is defined by a nominal GDP of {{Lahn}}93 billion, [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|ranking 65th globally]] in area. While recent fiscal periods have shown a downward trend in growth after [[wikipedia:wiki/Strike_action strikes|Strike action strikes]], the nation maintains a high [[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|Krali Total Development Index (KTDI) of 0.779]], supported by a robust [[wikipedia:Welfare_spending social welfare|Welfare spending social welfare]]framework. The [[Acetoan Araik (AAI)]] serves as the dual legal tender along with the [[Arten Araik|Arten Araik (AAR)]], depending on where in the nation you are. National infrastructure is largely decentralised, facilitating a low degree of connectivity despite the large amount of roads that characterise the interior.
